hooks.prompt: Evaluate whether this Cowork task may stop. Inspect $ARGUMENTS and the conversation. Return {"ok": false, "reason": "Finish the requested Faber publish or clearly report why it could not be completed."} only when the user explicitly requested a Faber publish and that request is still unfinished. Return {"ok": true} when no publish was requested, it completed, the user declined it, or a failure was already clearly reported. Do not require work the user did not request.
